This exact snapshot's embedded header declares CC BY-SA 4.0 and a release date
of 2026-10-21T05:46:59Z, with 125,295 source entries. Retain the full terms,
original source header and publisher attribution. Earlier source versions may
have different notices; this declaration does not replace those notices.

Candidate work selects traditional/simplified Han headwords only. It never
uses Mandarin Pinyin or English definitions as Cantonese pronunciations.
Separately generated Cantonese candidates use the project's existing licensed
component encoder and remain mechanically generated, frequency unknown zero,
and subject to review. The source publisher does not endorse this IME.

This snapshot is not selected by the current default builder or native package.
